studies.title: Victoria Falls
studies.caption: A broad curtain of water drops into a narrow gorge, sending spray above the surrounding trees.
studies.prompt: Diagonal view from the opposite forested rim across the Zambezi's very broad straight curtain of white water plunging into a narrow dark basalt fissure, spray rising above trees, wet leaves near viewer. No broad Niagara-style pool, no bridge or tourist platforms.
